opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not have held a full‑time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate, must have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date, and must be resident in the UK with a UK degree or UK academic position. Must not have held certain post‑doctoral fellowships or more than three years of post‑doctoral experience.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to enable early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research, with salary contribution and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants (Detailed Applications)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other UK higher‑education institutions (and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes) may apply. Principal Investigator must be employed by the institution and the institution must agree to administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative and original research projects up to five years, covering staff costs, research expenses and limited overheads.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Application must be made by an academic staff member at a UK university (or specialist arts institution) who will coordinate the visit. Host institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Funding to invite eminent overseas senior professors to undertake a visit of 3–12 months, enhancing skills and knowledge in under‑represented research areas.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must hold a post at a UK university with research degree awarding powers, be an experienced researcher whose teaching/administrative duties have limited research time, and be resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships of 3–24 months to support experienced researchers to complete a piece of research, with up to £70,000 available.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK university appointment (or nominated with a contract offer), must not have led a research team or held comparable large awards.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support talented early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership over 4–5 years.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution for two‑ or three‑year fellowship, plus up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at an eligible UK university; must not have previously held a Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowships for distinguished researchers to undertake original research, with salary support and limited research expenses.
